name: FIRST SALES MODE
goal: First 10 verified customers (Gumroad orders, not refunded) by Nov 10 2026

phases.name: build and test
phases.work: Audit site, products, checkout, delivery, tracking and every scheduled agent. Fix what is broken.

phases.name: flagship funnels
phases.work: Subscription Leak Hunter (subs-agent), Refund Fighter (refund-agent), Bill Lowering Coach (bill-agent): landing pages, demos, the All 5 Money Agents bundle, launch code in every CTA.

phases.name: viral distribution
phases.work: Evidence backed formats, original factory reels (2 a day, autopost after the 85/100 gate), lead capture, Meta ad test behind the verified winner.

phases.name: optimize
phases.work: Real traffic and sales only: fix the weakest funnel step, double down on verified winners, cut losers.

offer_code.name: LAUNCH30
offer_code.note: List prices stay the same. The Gumroad sync creates the code on each product and deletes it after 'until'.

ads.rule: Boost only the verified winning reel (best purchases, then guide clicks, then retention). Traffic or sales objective to the guide page, never engagement. Pause at the cap, on Nov 10 23:59 ART, or if 3 days spend gives zero guide clicks.

approvals.what: Standing autopost: factory reels that pass the 85/100 gate post 2 a day without per post approval, Nov 1 to Nov 10 only, then back to approval based
Push fixes and content to autopilotoi.app, landing pages and Gumroad product descriptions without asking each time, Nov 1 to Nov 10, no price changes
Meta ads, $10 a day, $60 total cap, behind the best performing reel from day 5
Launch discount code up to 30% off until Nov 10, list prices unchanged

News and prompt carousels autopost on Instagram, TikTok, Threads and X without per post approval when they pass the gate (every claim confirmed by 2 trusted sources, 85/100 quality score, no real people's photos, no logos as the main image), Nov 1 to Nov 10 only

still_needs_seb: Any new paid tool or subscription
Email broadcasts to the Kit list
rules: Purchases and profit over views. Every reel sells a live product or a flagship.
Keep the factory reel format: black and neon green factory top half, agent working live bottom half, strong hook, real demonstration, sample data labeled, product or free guide CTA.
85/100 quality gate before any post. Never fabricate metrics; missing data is MISSING.
No new agents or infrastructure unless a check proves something is broken.
Instagram 'Comment X' only for keywords in config/manychat.json; TikTok, Threads and X use link in bio or a direct link.
Respect cadence.max_per_day and cadence.slots_art on every network; check Metricool scheduled posts for the day before adding anything.

carousels.news_desk: hourly, all day (Seb: 'Every hour, all day')
carousels.daily_mix: 2 factory reels + 1 prompts carousel + breaking news when a big verified story drops (Seb: '2 reels + 1 prompts post + news (Recommended)')

cadence.set_by: Seb 2026-11-01: 'Thin everything out so that we don't over post, make sure everything you do is backed by real information and pick the best time'
cadence.instagram_mix: 10:00 conversion reel (flagships first during LAUNCH30), 18:00 news or prompts carousel
cadence.breaking_news: never adds a post over the cap; it takes the next open slot or replaces the lowest priority post in it (that post goes to draft)

evidence.best_times: Metricool getBestTimeToPostByNetwork for brand 7761544, Nov 1 to 7: Instagram peaks 10:00 every day (weekday values 4900 to 6700) with a second peak 17:00 to 18:00; TikTok peaks 10:00, 12:00 and 18:00. X best times not available (Metricool 403); Threads not supported by the endpoint, so they use the same slots.
evidence.frequency: Kontentino 2026: feed posts 3 to 5 per week, Reels 4 to 7 per week. socialcal.app: effective feed ceiling about 1 per day. TikTok creator resources: 1 to 4 per day.

cadence.draft_bank: Posts over the cap were moved to Metricool drafts (not deleted). The operator may promote one into an open slot when its topic or format is a proven winner.
